mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, we are seeing 65 degrees with overcast skies by Badger Ridge Middle School. The moon is in its Waning Gibbous phase, and while we have an overnight low of 65, please be prepared for some rain expected tonight.

The City of Verona Water Utility is currently partnering with specialists to perform cross connection control surveys to keep our water safe. You may receive a letter in the mail soon requesting an appointment for your property. Also, please note that a section of Highway M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 6 through October 9 for final road work.

There is plenty to do, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market taking place today. You can also catch trivia tonight at The Bogey Factory or look forward to Art Bar Happy Hour tomorrow at Art House 360.
On September 21, officers were dispatched to a two-vehicle crash involving minor injuries, where a 59-year-old Verona man was cited for operating too fast for the roadway conditions.
Today's flavor is the delicious Double Strawberry. The restaurant is open and serving guests until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
